fields.name: name
fields.label: Section Name
fields.description: The label shown for this tab panel in the Content Tree

fields.name: tab-id
fields.label: Tab ID
fields.description: Used for deep links (#tab-id). Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Defaults to the tab title.

validation.customErrorMsg: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only

fields.name: tab-icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Name of an icon in the project's /icons folder, e.g. info

fields.name: tab-badge
fields.label: Badge
fields.description: Short label shown on the tab, e.g. New

fields.name: tab-description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown on Card and Mega tab styles

fields.name: tab-thumbnail
fields.label: Image Thumbnail
fields.description: Shown on the Image tab style

fields.name: tab-active
fields.label: Default Active
fields.description: Open this tab when the page loads. The first active tab wins.

fields.name: tab-analytics
fields.label: Analytics Identifier
fields.description: Sent with the tab change event for analytics
